result.subject: Visit to London office – Tuesday 10 Nov
result.body:
Dear Tier-1 UK bank team,

We look forward to welcoming you on Tuesday 10 November at 14:00 for a product demo.

Our office is located at 3rd Floor, 21 Copper Row, London EC2A 4LT.

Please proceed to the reception on the ground floor and present photo ID to collect building passes. The nearest stations are Liverpool Street (6 min walk) and Moorgate (8 min). Guest Wi‑Fi details will appear on the welcome screen in your meeting room.

Your host, the Chief Revenue Officer, will meet you in the Boardroom.

Agenda:
- Welcome and introductions
- Your priorities and success criteria
- Live product demo
- Q&A and next steps

Kind regards,
Business Operations
